purpose: Select a diverse but bounded broad-prior lithology vocabulary without inventing local stratigraphic units.
preconditions: A supported natural geological domain has been classified
No route-applicable subsurface sequence evidence is available
decisionLogic: Choose only generalized material or weathering-state labels compatible with the classified domain
Do not convert mapped surface geology directly into a vertical sequence
Do not invent formation, member or group names
Mark every selected item SyntheticAssumption and visibly inferred
For volcanic or metamorphic mountain terrain, preserve two bounded terrain-following cover members before relief is assigned to a generalized principal rock body
uncertainty: Broad prior only; not a local subsurface interpretation
exclusions: Observed or literature status without route-applicable evidence
Claims of nationally unique vertical order
Relief absorption by thin fallout tephra, soil or weathering cover
reopenCondition: Route-applicable borehole, mapped-unit description, formation evidence or environment-specific transition data becomes available
